title: fix: declare the fixed resolution on five video models
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Five video models always produce a single resolution but don't declare it in the registry, so `/models` shows no `resolutions` for them and a caller who passes the resolution they actually get receives a 400 (`params.ts` only accepts values listed in `resolutions`).

| Model | Adapter always sends | Now declares |
|---|---|---|
| `alibaba/happyhorse-1.1` | 720p | `["720p"]` |
| `bytedance/seedance-2.0` | 720p | `["720p"]` |
| `alibaba/wan-2.2-fast` | 480p (primary + fal fallback) | `["480p"]` |
| `x-ai/grok-imagine-video` | 720p (primary + OpenRouter fallback) | `["720p"]` |
| `alibaba/wan-2.6` | 720p (all three routes) | `["720p"]` |

- Output, pricing and fallbacks are unchanged. The only runtime reader besides validation is Seedance's `resolutions?.[0] ?? "720p"`, which still yields 720p.
- Adds a registry test that every visible video model declares `resolutions`, and a params test that the fixed resolution is accepted.
- Tests: gen image suite (729), catalog/OpenAPI/fallback/docs tests and typecheck; Enter pricing, catalog and effective-price snapshot tests.
- No conflict with #15861 (different registry entries and fields).

Addresses #15599 — first step; image size and audio limits follow separately.

**Local E2E through gen (this branch, shared local D1, Tinybird events captured locally):**

| Request | HTTP | Output (ffprobe) | Billed | Event |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| wan-2.2-fast `resolution=480p` 5s | 200 | 832×480, 5.07s | 5s × 0.01 = 0.05 | replicate, no fallback |
| grok-imagine-video `resolution=720p` 1s | 200 | 720×720, 1.04s, audio | 1s × 0.07 = 0.07 | fal, no fallback |
| happyhorse-1.1 `resolution=720p` 3s | 200 | 960×960, 3.16s, audio | 3s × 0.104234 = 0.312702 | openrouter, no fallback |
| wan-2.6 `resolution=720p` 5s | 200 | 1280×720, 5.01s, audio | 5s × 0.1 = 0.5 | alibaba, no fallback |
| seedance-2.0 `resolution=720p` 4s | 200 | 1280×720, 4.06s, audio | 4s × 0.18 = 0.72 | replicate, no fallback |
| seedance-2.0 no `resolution` 4s | 200 | 1280

gist.headline: Five videos find their pixels
gist.blurb: Five video models finally say what resolution they make. Asking for that same resolution no longer confuses the API.
gist.summary: The video model registry declares fixed resolutions for alibaba/happyhorse-1.1, bytedance/seedance-2.0, x-ai/grok-imagine-video, and alibaba/wan-2.6 at 720p, plus alibaba/wan-2.2-fast at 480p, so /models lists them and validation accepts matching requests.
gist.impact: Callers can specify 720p for the four 720p models or 480p for wan-2.2-fast without a resolution-validation 400; video output, pricing, and fallbacks stay unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Polli helps a friendly CRT monitor robot label five little video screens in a garden workspace: four marked 720p and one marked 480p. A lime-green code-plant ties the screens together, representing registry metadata that agrees with what the models produce.
